title: HBO’s 14-Part Mystery Thriller Has One Of Its Best Casts & It’s The Perfect Binge
summary: Big Little Lies features one of HBO's best casts, including Nicole Kidman, Reese Witherspoon, Laura Dern & Meryl Streep, across 14 gripping episodes.
content: HBO 's 14-part mystery thriller boasts one of its greatest ensemble casts, delivering a gripping murder mystery that's perfect for your next binge. Even though its first season premiered back in 2017, this acclaimed thriller series remains one of the best shows to binge-watch on HBO Max , especially for fans of suspenseful crime dramas with psychological elements like Furious , Ripley , and The Sinner . Featuring an absolutely stacked cast led by Nicole Kidman, this mystery series has withstood the test of time as the ultimate 14-part binge on HBO Max.

title: 178-Episode Urban Fantasy Series Has One Of TV's Most Iconic Lead Trios
summary: This classic 178-episode witchy urban fantasy series introduced one of TV's most iconic leading trios. Three is a magic number, after all.
content: This classic eight-season urban fantasy show introduced one of TV's most iconic central trios. Urban fantasy shows were all the rage in the 90s and early 00s, with shows like Xena: Warrior Princess , Buffy the Vampire Slayer , The X-Files , and Supernatural dominating pop culture. Xena , Buffy , and The X-Files explored contemporary themes through a paranormal lens, centering on female characters and their relationships, ambitions, and desires.

title: HBO’s $100 Million Historical Miniseries Is Worth Every Penny
summary: HBO has a habit of spending big on historical miniseries for better or for worse, but they definitely made the right call with this modern TV classic.
content: HBO is famous for stretching its finances on high-profile historical TV shows, often with mixed results. But one miniseries it produced in the genre is worth every cent of its nine-figure budget. The series spotlights an icon whose life and political career had a lasting effect on the world, but who is frequently overlooked in favor of his contemporaries.

title: The Walking Dead Meets The Division In New Zombie Survival Shooter
summary: If you're a fan of shows like The Walking Dead and games like The Division, this could be the zombie adventure you've been looking for.
content: If you loved the post-apocalyptic setting of The Last of Us but are looking for a more action-heavy shooter such as Tom Clancy's: The Division , this upcoming multiplayer zombie survival game may just be the game you are looking for. Heck, even if you're just a big fan of zombie survival shows like The Walking Dead , this could be the game for you.

title: Netflix's 12-Minute Sci-Fi Short Is So Good, Everyone Should Watch It At Least Once
summary: There's a lot of essential viewing in the Netflix library, but nothing feels worth the time investment like this mind bending animated short film.
content: Netflix has plenty of shows that are often labeled as essential viewing, depending on who is making the recommendation. Few, however, earn that description quite like Love, Death & Robots . Created by Tim Miller, the four-volume series initially looks like yet another animated sci-fi anthology with a particularly generous appetite for violence. Watch a little longer, however, and the true scale of its ambition becomes clear. When LD+R is at its best, these surreal, vibrant shorts blur the boundary between popular entertainment and art.

title: Netflix’s Next Big Political Thriller Brings Back An Iconic Spy Trend
summary: Glamorous Washington power plays collide with naval command secrets in a tense, elite backroom thriller that sees Netflix revive an iconic trend.
content: While Netflix ’s next major thriller series won’t arrive until December, the show has already managed to revive a TV trend that hasn’t been seen in action since the 2010s. Like every other industry, TV and streaming go through trend cycles wherein certain types of shows will be popular for a stretch of time, only to fade from public relevance after enough titles try to replicate their appeal.

title: Red Dead Redemption 3 Perfect Protagonist Unites Gamers
summary: With GTA 6 finally out in the wild, gamers are dreaming about Red Dead Redemption 3's perfect lead character.
content: It may not have been officially announced just yet, but now that GTA 6 is finally out in the wild, we're back to dreaming about our perfect protagonist for Red Dead Redemption 3 . With the Red Dead franchise being one of the most successful in gaming history, it's hardly a surprise that Rockstar is under pressure to deliver the next installment. Although with GTA 6 's Online mode still to come, and the 13 years between GTA 5 and GTA 6 , we may be in for a wait.

title: Star Trek's Brand New Crew Officially Met With Mixed Reviews
summary: Any new Star Trek iteration relies on a compelling crew, but the latest effort seems to have been poorly received for several reasons.
content: Any new Star Trek adaptation lives or dies by several key facets, not least the crew who take to the stars on our behalf to explore the galaxy. That's why shows like The Next Generation did so well, because Picard et Al were compelling characters who were able to deliver the narrative in a way that felt real and grounded, despite it being so fantastical in nature.

title: Tom Hardy’s 20-Part Gangster Masterpiece Is Officially The Perfect Binge This Weekend
summary: Tom Hardy's MobLand is the perfect weekend binge on Paramount+, with all 20 episodes available following season 2's finale drop on Friday, Nov 27.
content: Tom Hardy's 20-part gangster masterpiece is officially the perfect weekend binge, with two complete seasons of gripping crime drama now streaming on Paramount+ . This series is currently the #2 most-watched on Paramount+ in the world heading into the holiday weekend and has been one of the most consistently popular series on the platform throughout all of Fall 2026. Led by Hardy, Pierce Brosnan, Helen Mirren, and one of the best casts on any modern streaming series, there has never been a better time to binge this crime drama than now.

title: The Witcher: Legacy Officially Lands June 2027
summary: The Witcher is about to return to prominence in a big way, and an upcoming release will only add to that excitement from fans.
content: The Witcher really feels as though its on the cusp of returning right to the top of the proverbial tree, and not a moment too soon, as the beloved franchise has sat on the sidelines for far too long. We all knew The Witcher 4 was coming at some point, but what far fewer fans were expecting was confirmation that the third game was going to get one final DLC, a decade on from the last.
